The '''vibro-lance''' or '''vibrolance''' was a large powered [[Spear/Legends|spear]]-like weapon that vibrated rapidly upon impact, dramatically increasing the amount of damage delivered while minimizing the effort required by the wielder.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

Among the wielders of these weapons were the [[Witches of Dathomir]]<ref name="SWG" /> and [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards who used them against slaves or prisoners.

A vibro-lance was used by [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] Guard [[Thok (Gamorrean guard)/Legends|Thok]] in [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] palace on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Another lance was given to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] by the Dathomirian witch [[Vhaunda]].<ref name="SWG" />

Imperial Assassin [[Ennix Devian]] used a retractable vibro-lance during his fight with [[Kir Kanos]].
